resources.string: feat(session): add portrait sessions and controls below the game

Steam, games, and Linux desktop sessions can now use Portrait or Follow device rotation independently of launcher orientation. Landscape remains the default. Resolution presets rotate with the session; custom dimensions remain exact, and older automatic resolution preferences retain preset behavior.
Make the performance HUD measure the game\'s frames like Steam\'s overlay

The performance HUD (green, top right) showed a jagged frame-time line and a lower fps than Steam\'s performance overlay (MangoHud) for the same game. In Among Us, Steam showed a flat 60 fps line while the HUD read 51-56 fps with spikes.
Pushed to main without a PR - fix: stop starting a session on the slow proot (#1395)
refactor: remove duplicate session frame limiter

DroidDeck\'s Mode settings frame cap duplicates Steam QAM and can leave users with two competing limiters. Remove the session-wide control and its saved-setting/runtime wiring so Steam\'s Quick Access menu owns Steam game frame limits.
fix: show a desktop window game\'s real fps on the HUD
In the KDE desktop, a game started from Steam runs in a desktop window (#1584), but the performance HUD showed 0 fps the whole time even though the game was running smoothly.
fix: Battle.net games the Agent no longer tracks stay out of the Library

Battle.net games that were no longer installed still showed in the Library, Steam and the Stores grid. World of Warcraft and StarCraft also vanished from the Battle.net client even though their files were still on the Games folder (124 GB and 5.4 GB).
fix: list Battle.net store games in a grid that scrolls down

The Battle.net store put its whole catalog in a single \"Blizzard games\" shelf. That made one row that scrolled sideways, with empty space below. The shelf also stops at 24 cards, so the last 7 of the 31 titles could not be reached at all: Warcraft II: Remastered, Warcraft Rumble, Doom: The Dark Ages, Sea of Thieves, The Outer Worlds 2, Tony Hawk\'s Pro Skater and Avowed.
Hold games to the frame limit in Performance mode
With Performance mode on and a frame limit set, games are now held to the limit instead of drawing frames the screen never shows.
feat(ui): support portrait launcher layouts

DroidDeck can now follow device rotation or stay in portrait. Tall windows use navigation at the bottom edge, while landscape keeps the side rail. Launcher orientation is separate from Steam/game/desktop orientation and also applies to the file browser, file picker, and store sign-in activities.
feat: install Battle.net games from Stores with downloads, updates and uninstall
Battle.net games now install from Stores the same way Epic, Xbox and itch games do:
DroidDeck-Proton is downloaded, kept up to date and used by default
DroidDeck-Proton becomes the Proton games use by default. It is downloaded on its own, kept up to date, and each update replaces the older build without losing anyone\'s choices.
feat: merge Games and store libraries into one Library and one game page

The same game could be found in three places with two different detail pages. Now there is one Library for every owned game, one game page for every source, and Stores is only for getting games. The Steam tab is untouched.
fix: GOG sign-in pages use the browser\'s own user agent
Fixes #1486
Xbox Cloud Gaming: stream from the store and Games tab, native player with DroidDeck frame generation
Stream Xbox games with Xbox Cloud Gaming from DroidDeck, outside the Linux session, with an opt-in native player that runs DroidDeck\'s own frame generation on the stream.
Xbox: fix sign-in on phones with a slow StrongBox Keystore
Share installed games between the arm64 and x86-64 Steam clients

The x86-64 Steam client and the arm64 one kept separate libraries, so a game installed in one showed as not installed in the other and had to be downloaded again. Each client now sees the other\'s installed games as installed and runs them from the same files.
Focus flatpak and other sandboxed shortcuts in gaming mode

A Flatpak app added to Steam as a non-Steam game opened from Big Picture, but the screen stayed on Steam\'s loading spinner with only the app\'s sound. Battle.net launched the same way (DD-273) showed the same thing.
Automatically update installed Proton builds on app open

Automatically update installed Proton families while idle under suitable network and power conditions, preserving older builds and pinned selections with launch exclusion and a persistent retry cooldown (30 focused tests passed).
fix(desktop): keep the Desktop page from overlapping on phones

On phones in landscape, the Desktop page\'s big \"Desktop\" title overlapped the Emulators & apps cards once the desktop was installed. The Uninstall button sat under the store and + buttons, which made that block taller and pushed the title up into the cards.
Stop the library helper when the KDE Steam client exits
After you quit Steam\'s desktop client in KDE, it could not be opened again until the session restarted. The second launch waited and then reported that the desktop client did not become ready.
fix: Frame Limit sync and refresh follow on a still screen (review follow-ups)
Two follow-ups from CodeRabbit\'s review of #1650:
fix: show gesture settings only in gesture mode
The session drawer now shows Touch gesture settings only when Touch is set to Gestures, and removes the explanatory text beneath it.
Components: keep game FEX/DXVK choices on Proton builds installed later (StarCraft launch)

StarCraft (Battle.net, installed from Stores) opens and closes again right away. The 32-bit client dies in ClientSdk.dll\'s DllMain with an execute access violation (c0000005, info 8, raised in libwow64fex.dll). Every launch ends with \"Battle.net closed before a game started\".
feat: Steam\'s Frame Limit decides; gamescope and the limit follow the refresh rate

• Performance mode switch removed. Sessions always run the way Performance mode did. Steam\'s Frame Limit in the Quick Access menu is the only frame limit. It decides whether a game is capped or uncapped (the app\'s own limiter was already removed in #1616).\n• The Frame Limit slider stays correct when the refresh rate changes. If your limit is still offered at the new rate, it is kept. If not (for e
feat: trust contributors for test builds

Automatically publish release-signed test builds for fork PRs opened by contributors listed in .github/trusted-test-builds.txt, regardless of who pushes. The initial list contains FX192, kingokksa, and ovurrsl. The existing automatic signing of same-repository PR builds remains in place, including successful reruns.
fix(input): keep AYN system key out of Home shortcuts
On the AYN Thor, enabling Home button shortcuts (#1637) also turned the AYN button under the bottom screen into a held Steam Guide, so it no longer opened AYN\'s panel.
Decode Remote Play streams on the arm64 Steam client
Fixes Remote Play from a PC to the arm64 Steam client on the tablet (#381, #1075).
fix(skate.): run ReSkate at D3D12 feature level 121
Do not merge until the ReSkate testers confirm it.
fix(proton): Windows games see only the cores they are pinned to
DD-277 (Discord): Prototype only works when it is held to two CPU cores. With Game cores set to two cores, it still freezes at the splash screen most of the time.
feat(itch): collections filter in the Library

Adds itch.io collections to the Library. On the itch tab, a new Collections button in the header lets you pick one of your account\'s collections. Picking one hides every game that isn\'t in it. Games in the collection that aren\'t installed show in the existing \"Not installed\" section. \"All\" brings the full library back.
perf(gamescope): p18 – handle a finished frame in one loop pass

Every finished game frame took two passes of gamescope\'s main loop (the gamescope-xwm thread). The Xwayland commit woke it to import the buffer: it duplicated the buffer\'s fence and handed the commit to the image waiter (epoll add). Then the gamescopeimg thread saw the fence signalled, removed and closed it, and woke the main loop again to handle the finished commit. At 3,000+ fps that is a l
perf(compositor): draw a new frame when it arrives

The compositor drew a new game frame only at the next screen tick, so each frame waited for the tick before it was drawn: 1.9–3.5 ms on average at 144 Hz, measured with the pacing counters from #1678. With FIFO, a frame drawn at the tick is shown one refresh later than one drawn when it arrives.
fix(steam): answer Steam\'s D3D driver query without starting Wine

At every start, Steam\'s shader pre-caching runs d3ddriverquery64.exe (with and without -d3d12) through each Proton tool – DroidDeck-Proton and the ARM64 Proton – in compatdata/0. On DroidDeck the query never succeeds: 948 of 948 runs in the client\'s shader log failed (mostly exit code 1), and Steam ends with \"Unknown shader cache type, ignoring.\"
fix: show every held volume step in Steam\'s volume slider
Holding a volume key moved Steam\'s QAM volume slider in uneven jumps with a stall at the start, instead of tracking Android\'s steady ramp.
feat(session): manual pause button in the session menu

Adds a Pause button to the in-session menu\'s top row, left of Picture in picture. It pauses the session in every Background behavior (Auto, Native, Manual, Never) and holds until Resume, including across leaving and returning to the app.
fix: avoid incompatible Turnip selection and explain Steam startup failures

Two startup failures currently end with a generic stopped-session message: #1376 reports Steam exiting with Illegal instruction / status 132 after installation, while #1368 reports a non-Adreno MT6993 device starting with Turnip and gamescope failing to find a Vulkan device.
fix: an unproven update-channel guess no longer moves stable users to Nightly
Stable users are no longer silently switched to the Nightly (Preview) update channel when DroidDeck can\'t yet tell which channel they installed from.
Add opt-in game debug logs and bounded log sharing
This is also work that came about from my #570 PR.
fix(library): keep installed/all owned filter when stores tab is off
Disabling the Stores tab hid the Installed / All owned games filter in Library. The filter now shows regardless of the Stores setting (still hidden in the shortcut picker).
fix(proton): Windows CPU 0 is the fastest core
GTA IV ran at half speed in DroidDeck: 32 fps against 64–66 in Bannerlator, with the same settings, DXVK and FEX.
ci: faster pipeline and fewer network flakes

• Python regression suite now runs in 3 parallel groups (tools/ci/run-python-tests.sh) instead of serially.
• Gradle unit tests use up to 2 forks on CI.
• Recipe curl downloads retry connection resets (exit 56) via --retry-all-errors; the earlier failures were Build proot hitting this.
• Pushes to main cancel superseded main builds; docs/ and issue templates no longer trigger builds.
• Gradle cache cleanup runs only outside PRs.
tool: deploy session helper changes by grafting them into the latest main APK

python tools/deployfast.py takes the newest release-signed main build from DroidDeck-CI that this checkout descends from, replaces the session helper assets whose sources changed, re-signs with the local release signer and optionally installs (--install). --plan shows what would change.
perf(proot): accelerate and cache glibc syscall relays

Libc-internal file operations bypass the existing preload wrappers and still stop in PRoot. Patch recognized ARM64 SVC sites in libc and the runtime loader, reuse the current translator for 20 path syscall numbers, and return declined calls to PRoot. Enabled by default after the tracer-key check; PROOTFPPATCHSVC=0 remains the troubleshooting opt-out.
fix: cancelling the first-run desktop or Proton install stops its download
Pressing Cancel (or B) while a session is installing the desktop or the Steam-mode Proton seed now stops the download. Launching again right after no longer opens a session screen that closes itself.
feat(itch): update detection and safe updates for installed games

Adds update detection for installed itch.io games. This is PR4 of the itch.io store rework (browse, filters, game page and collections are merged; Linux support is #1589). Butler patching comes later as an add-on pack. Updates here download the full build.
fix(game-env): OpenGL games stop waiting for each screen refresh

With no frame limit, AIO\'s Direct3D 7 (DirectDraw) test ran at exactly 144 fps on the 144 Hz AYANEO Pocket FIT: frame times averaged 6.94 ms, one refresh each (D3D11 on the same build: 0.26 ms). Every frame waited for the screen refresh.
Warn when a game library drive is linked at USB 2.0 speed

When a drive that DroidDeck uses as a game library (the Second library / game storage volume, or a Games folder on an external drive) is linked slower than USB 3 (5 Gbps), DroidDeck shows a warning in the usual app dialog style:
feat: art-first store cards

• Store catalog cards (shelves and grid) use the same art-only card as the Library: name and price/size on a slim fade over the art, status chip in the corner, download bar on top.\n• The Library\'s art card is now a shared ArtCard, so both pages stay in step. The old label-strip CardFace is removed.\n• The Display menu (card size, show title, show size) is on the store page header too and shares the
fix(storage): stack the summary card in narrow panes

On narrow portrait screens the Storage summary card kept its side-by-side layout, so the 170-210dp \'Safe to free now\' panel squeezed the usage text to a few characters per line. Narrow panes now stack the usage block above a divider and the clean-up panel.
feat: art-first library cards with a display menu

• Library cards are now art only. The label strip, the per-card store badge (kept on the All tab) and the not-installed dimming are gone.\n• Name and size sit on a slim fade over the bottom of the art, so touch-only devices still see them. The focused card expands to two lines.\n• Art is never cropped for near-matching shapes. Ultra-wide banners (GOG, Steam) fill the wide card by trimming the far ed
feat: FusionHUD replaces the session HUD, with MangoHud\'s readings

DroidDeck\'s session HUD and Steam\'s performance overlay could show different numbers for the same game, which confuses people comparing the two. This replaces the session HUD with FusionHUD (Bannerlator\'s HUD) and takes every reading from the same source, worked out the same way, as the MangoHud build that runs Steam\'s performance overlay in a DroidDeck session (Valve\'s mangohud-20260902.1). It
Update Xbox backend to 0.2.12
Update the pinned Nexus backend from 0.2.8 to 0.2.12 and rebase the existing DroidDeck patches for credential transport, launch views, and cloud-token support.
feat: game page with art backdrop and frosted controls
The game page (Library and Stores) now uses the game\'s art as the page background, with frosted capsules for the controls, in place of the boxed hero card.
fix(ui): keep the ring veil count per test

RingVeil\'s snapshot state was created inside whichever test touched it first and then shared, so a later Compose test could fail with a snapshot read error depending on how tests were distributed across forks. The shared compose rule now resets it. Four forks were also measured at 195 s against 121 s for two, so the fork count stays at two.
ci: run unit tests in two parallel forks
Halves the serial unit-test step. Forks were reverted earlier because tests shared process-wide state; this branch finds and fixes those.
ci: run store engine host tests in a parallel job

Moves the non-blocking cargo test for the store engines (25-39 s serial in the build job) into its own job that only needs the pinned source, so it overlaps the Gradle build. It stays non-gating as before (continue-on-error), with its own host-target cargo cache.
perf(fex): answer raw stat, readlink and statx syscalls through the proot fast path

FEX issues most of its path lookups as raw syscall() calls (newfstatat, readlinkat, statx) rather than through the libc wrappers. The session preload already routes raw openat, openat2 and execveat into the proot fast path, but these three still fell through to ptrace, so every one of them cost a full tracer round trip.
fix: Steam\'s UI draws at an even share of the refresh near 60 fps instead of the panel\'s full rate (lag and heat since 0.6.7)

Since 0.6.7, Steam\'s Big Picture UI lags on several devices, and the device heats up quickly while sitting in Steam. 0.6.0 stays cool. A Discord user posted the same library scroll on 0.6.7 fresh, 0.6.0 fresh and 0.6.7 updated: 49 stalls over 100 ms on 0.6.7 against 1 on 0.6.0 (Galaxy S26 Ultra). It was also reported on an S26, an AYN Thor Max and others.
fix: the performance HUD is off by default and keeps the user\'s own choice
Since 0.6.7, users see the performance HUD (FPS, CPU, GPU, RAM, battery bar) in every session without having turned it on. Several asked on Discord how to remove it.
fix: the Duo\'s bottom screen keeps the panel you picked across games

On the Retroid Pocket Duo (and other dual-screen handhelds), the bottom screen doesn\'t stay on the panel the user chose. When the user switches it to Trackpad (or Terminal), the next game session opens Deck controls again.
fix(itch): install games whose download is an archive inside an archive

Reported on Discord (POCO F6, 0.6.7): itch.io installs fail with \"no exe found\" when the download is an archive that holds another archive. Voices of the Void ships a .zip whose only payload is a .7z, and the .exe is inside the .7z. The installer unpacked one level, found no .exe, and gave up.
fix: keep the launcher from reclaiming focus when an app opens on the primary screen

On dual-screen devices with the launcher panel on, choosing Primary screen for an app that was not running appeared to do nothing. The app launched, then the panel activity on the other display resumed and its returnFocus pulled the launcher task back over it.
fix: Steam\'s Browse buttons work when another app holds port 8080 with Decky enabled
On a Thor in the desktop session, Steam\'s Add a Non-Steam Game → Browse… does nothing. The user\'s desktop log shows:
Windows components: restore bundle parts, wait for restores and keep older picks
Follow-up to Droid-Deck/DroidDeck#1786, covering the review points raised after it was merged.
fix: Windows installs to Android storage no longer ask for an administrator

Installing a Battle.net game (reported with WoW) to a folder on Android storage (Z:, a microSD card or a USB SSD such as a Samsung T9) fails with \"Please try again after logging on as an administrator\" (BLZBNTAGT00000841). Installing to C: works. Symlinks don\'t help. Other stores that check folder permissions can hit the same thing.
Update the Linux runtime by itself when a new one is out

A new Linux runtime (for example ubuntu-r1-rc2, which fixes Steam on rc1) only installed when the user opened the runtime menu and pressed the button. Many users updated the app but kept running the old runtime, along with its bugs.
Keep Windows components across runtime updates and reinstall lost ones

After the runtime update, games that needed Windows components (DirectX, VC++ runtimes, XAudio, PhysX and others) stopped working. The component store at /opt/droiddeck/wincomponents lives inside the runtime, so it was not carried over to the new one. On the next launch, droiddeck-wincomponents saw that the picked components were missing and removed the DLLs they had placed in each game\'s pref
feat: Steam\'s sleep-after timers start every session as Disabled

• At every session start, before the Steam client launches, set Power > "Sleep after" (on battery and plugged in) to Disabled in each Steam home's config.vdf.
• Android owns the device's sleep; a client that suspends inside the session only shows a black screen that Android doesn't know about.
• Only IdleSuspendBatterySeconds and IdleSuspendACSeconds are forced. Dim display and screensaver timers stay the user's.
• A change made in Steam's Power page applies for the running session and resets at the next launch.
fix: Steam\'s UI runs at the panel\'s full refresh rate again

Reported on Discord after the latest Preview: games run at 120 fps, but Steam Big Picture is locked at 60 on a 120 Hz screen, with power saving off and the vendor game manager disabled. Users expect the Steam UI to run at the panel\'s refresh rate, like games and the desktop do.
fix: launching a game from a frontend starts it instead of sitting on the home screen
A game link (droiddeck://game/<id>, the LAUNCHGAME intent) sometimes left DroidDeck on its home screen with Play Steam until the user tapped.
fix(runtime): cutscenes and in-game videos play again with DroidDeck-Proton (libva-drm2, libva-x11-2)
Fixes the 0.6.7 video regression reported on Discord (Video Playback Regression on 0.6.7, There some bugs on new Linux using DD proton, KH1.5+2.5 crashing at FMV cutscene).
feat: cap the frame rate in session for games launched without Steam

• Adds a Frame limit row to the in-session drawer\'s Display page for games launched without Steam (Off, 30, 40, 45, 60, 90, 120).\n• The limit applies live: it paces the compositor and the display switches to a refresh rate the cap divides evenly, as the old Display setting did.\n• It lasts for the session and resets when the next one starts. Steam games keep using Steam\'s Frame Limit in the Quick A
feat: Add physical controller button shortcuts

• Assign physical controller buttons to Steam, Quick Access, or DroidDeck menus, with per-controller settings and reset.\n• Preserve default behavior for unassigned buttons and add translations for all supported languages.
fix: a game with a launch-option picker is no longer closed while the picker is open (MK11)
Fixes the Discord report \"MK11 won\'t run\" (Mortal Kombat 11 on a RedMagic 11 Pro: it opens, then drops back to DroidDeck without booting, on 0.6.7 and every preview since).
fix: library filter, sort and display menus aren\'t cut off in portrait
Fixes the Discord report \"Library filter menus in portrait look weird, face wrong direction cut off\".
fix(audio): DirectAudio no longer crackles where Android refuses low-latency output
Fixes #1843 and #1819 (audio crackling and popping in Proton games with DirectAudio).
feat: test and local builds show a faint PR, commit and title watermark

• Test PR builds and local builds draw a small white-on-gray tag in the bottom-right corner of every activity (launcher, in-session menu, games, Steam, desktop), so a screenshot or screen share shows what build is running.\n• PR builds: PR-1234 | abc1234 plus the PR title cut to 80 characters. Local builds: LOCAL | abc1234 plus the branch name.\n• Stable and preview builds (CI builds without a PR nu
perf: .NET games keep the FEX preset\'s multiblock setting (Stardew Valley starts in 45 s instead of 85 s)

Every game that ships coreclr.dll (.NET 5+ games such as Stardew Valley) gets a fixed FEX profile from droiddeck-game-env. That profile turned FEX multiblock off on top of full TSO, overriding the user\'s global FEX preset (Performance + TSO by default, which has multiblock on). Multiblock off makes FEX translate x86 code one block at a time, and .NET\'s JIT produces a lot of fresh code while a
feat: the HUD is DroidDeck HUD, pinch resizes it, and pushing it off an edge docks it as an FPS tab

• Every HUD class, setting and label that said Fusion HUD now says DroidDeck HUD (DroidDeckHudView, DroidDeckHudHost, DroidDeckHudConfig, DroidDeckHudSettings, DroidDeckHudSize, and the HUD diagnostics report heading).\n• The HUD page of the session menu no longer shows the FusionHUD / The412Banner credit line, and its hudcredit string is removed from every locale.\n• The accent dot at the left edge
Ask for All files access when a USB drive is mounted but unreadable

On some Samsung phones a USB drive shows up in the file manager but tapping it only shows \"is mounted but not readable right now\". Android mounts the drive but blocks DroidDeck from reading it until All files access is granted. The manifest already declares MANAGEEXTERNALSTORAGE, but DroidDeck never asked for it, so users had to find the setting themselves.
fix: \"DroidDeck isn\'t responding\" on dual-screen handhelds after the bottom screen takes focus
Fixes \"DroidDeck isn\'t responding\" on the Retroid Pocket Duo when pressing RB/LB on the Stores tab (and other pages) after the bottom screen has taken focus.
Refuse Flatpak bundles built for another architecture with a clear message

On Discord, a user installed r2modman from a .flatpak bundle in desktop mode. The install finished, but the app closed straight away every time it was opened. Their log (DroidDeck-2026-10-30-01-desktop.zip, Samsung SM-F976B) shows why:
fix: Linux games on an NTFS USB drive start the first time instead of failing to load a library

A native Linux game installed on a USB drive formatted NTFS (a Samsung SSD on the RedMagic Astra 2) closed about 14 seconds after launch, and the session returned to the launcher. The session log showed:
fix: stop importing games as Spacewar (480) and follow a changed Steam app id
An added game whose steamappid.txt says 480 disappears from the Library and shows up as Spacewar.
fix: dual-screen update prompt survives a bottom-screen tap, home launcher stays out of Recents, Quest panel opens landscape
Fixes three dual-screen and panel launcher bugs reported on Discord: DD-368, DD-377 and DD-360. DD-382 was already fixed by #1871; it is re-checked below.
zRAM: compress Battle.net with the Steam client while one of its games runs
Test build only. Do not merge yet.
docs: DroidDeck 0.6.9 release notes

• Adds docs/releases/0.6.9.md, the DroidDeck 0.6.9 release notes covering the 60 pull requests merged to main since 0.6.7, including #1903, with authors and PR links in the 0.6.7 format.\n• Adds docs/releases/media/0.6.9/controller-shortcuts.jpg, the Button mapping screen with the new physical button shortcuts, captured on a Retroid Pocket Duo.
fix: three-finger tap opens the keyboard in touchpad mode

A user reported that a three-finger tap pasted clipboard text instead of opening the keyboard. In touchpad mode (the default for desktop sessions and Steam\'s desktop UI), a three-finger tap was sent as a middle click, which pastes the X11 primary selection.
fix: \"DroidDeck isn\'t responding\" on dual-screen handhelds after the bottom screen sits idle
Follow-up to #1806 and #1871 for the \"DroidDeck isn\'t responding\" report on the AYN Thor (Discord #bug-reports, \"New update forces auto focus on ayn thor\"; also reported by a second Thor user).
fix(game-env): give Codemasters EGO games a thread plan for the core count Windows sees

Codemasters EGO games (DiRT 3, DiRT Showdown, GRID, F1 ...) pick their thread plan by core count from system/hardwaresettingsrestrictions.xml in the game folder. The shipped files have plans for 2, 3, 4, 6 and 8+ cores only.
fix: performance HUD cycles colors with the Inner Gamer theme

With the Inner Gamer theme, the drawer and the rest of the app cycle through the color wheel, but the performance HUD kept the color it read when its config was applied (e.g. a green HUD next to a yellow drawer).
fix(dual-screen): open the bottom-screen Dashboard in every session, not only the first

On dual-screen handhelds the bottom-screen Dashboard only opened by itself in the first Steam session after DroidDeck started. When Steam was closed and started again without closing the app, the bottom screen stayed on Android\'s own launcher.
perf: Little Nightmares keeps its render thread (+12.7% FPS on the Retroid Pocket Duo)

A bottleneck study of the Retroid Pocket Duo (Adreno 722, 8 GB, Android 16) with Little Nightmares, covering every layer a Windows game passes through: PRoot, FEX, Proton/Wine, DXVK, Turnip and the presentation path.
feat(dual-screen): bottom-screen Dashboard with downloads, notifications, screenshots, Steam chat and In-game stats

Dual-screen handhelds like the Retroid Pocket Duo leave the second screen black while a game runs. This adds a Dashboard for it: downloads, notifications, screenshots, Steam chat with voice controls, and live in-game stats.
fix(hud): GPU clock and load without root on Adreno 8xx and hardware-scheduled kernels

On phones where Android blocks the GPU\'s sysfs files for apps, the HUD reads the GPU without root (#1969). That works on the Retroid Pocket Duo (Adreno 722) but not on Adreno 8xx: a OnePlus 13 (Adreno 830, Android 16) showed no GPU clock and only the partial GPU load from Vulkan timing. Reported with two HUD diagnostics files by iamTooShaar on Discord.
feat(dual-screen): single-screen mode on the Retroid Pocket Duo and AYN Thor while another window holds the bottom screen
On the Retroid Pocket Duo and the AYN Thor, DroidDeck now switches to single-screen mode while something else holds the bottom screen, and back to dual-screen mode when it\'s free again.
fix: remove the Bottom screen HUD descriptions from the HUD settings
Drops the group description and the subtitles on the Bottom screen HUD and Strip on every tab rows.
fix(game-env): DOOM (2016) keeps the swapchain image count it asks for
DOOM (2016) crashes on every launch with \"The engine has crashed!\" (GOG install, Vulkan). With this change it starts and reaches its menus.
feat(dual-screen): bottom-screen HUD, Line strip, strip under every bottom tab, Bottom screen HUD settings
Bottom-screen HUD work for dual-screen devices (tested on the Retroid Pocket Duo), squashed to one commit on main da665bb1.
fix: docked HUD tab FPS number is half its previous size

The docked FPS tab was disproportionately large next to the full HUD. The number drops from 20sp to 10sp, the \"fps\" label from 8.5sp to 6sp, and the padding scales with it. The tab still scales with the HUD scale setting. The sizes are now shared constants used by the build, size and drag-preview paths.
feat: Auto picks DD-Turnip on Adreno 7xx
Auto now prefers the newest DD-Turnip release on the Adreno 7xx, the 710/720/722 included.
feat: manage several Steam libraries beside internal and the card

Steam gets the internal library plus a single "second library". Users on Discord keep asking for more:
• an SD library for big games and an internal folder outside the Linux runtime (so a runtime repair or reinstall doesn't take the games with it)
• a GameNative / other-launcher folder alongside the SD card
• a USB drive or a Documents/Steam folder alongside the card
chore: remove source comments and unused code, translate every missing string
Clean-up only. Nothing here is meant to change how the app behaves.
feat(hud): GPU load and clock without root where Android blocks kgsl
Some phones, like the Retroid Pocket Duo, block apps from reading the GPU numbers, so DroidDeck\'s HUD showed no GPU % and no GPU clock there. Without root, this PR adds:
fix(runtime): keep the Linux desktop installed across a runtime update
After every Linux runtime update, the Desktop button went back to \"Install & open desktop\", and opening it downloaded the whole Kubuntu desktop again, even though it had been installed before.
feat: Mali Vulkan support through MaliBridge
Re-landing #1950 as a merge commit so ASEbrahim, maxjivi05 and mr-abccc keep their commits. Same branch head (80da86a) that passed CI there.
preload: set PRSETCHILDSUBREAPER so double-forked Xwayland is not orphaned to init
On some vendor kernels (reported on Meizu 20 / Flyme 12.6, Snapdragon 8 Gen 2) DroidDeck hangs forever on \"Starting display and audio\". session.log ends with two lines and then goes silent:
fix: a stale session\'s startup failure no longer stops the newer session

runSession(gen) runs on a background thread and calls stopSession(...) when startup fails (passwd/group write, missing proot, game environment publish, run mode without a program, guest start failure). stopSession only checked SessionState.running, so if the user quit and started a new session while the old one was still starting, the old session\'s failure tore down the new session.
fix: a GOG game whose installer cannot run gets its install registry

The Witcher: Enhanced Edition installs from GOG, is registered in Steam, and then witcher.exe exits during startup. Wine\'s log shows the runtime and audio loading, then the engine tearing down and err:virtual:virtualsetupexception nested exception on signal stack.
fix(battlenet): list World of Warcraft: Forever in the Library
World of Warcraft: Forever installed through Battle.net never appeared in the Library, while Retail, Classic and StarCraft did.
feat(dual-screen): swap screens - game on the bottom screen, panel on top
Swap screens for dual-screen handhelds (tested on the Retroid Pocket Duo), on main 3fbd86c8.
fix: bottom screen frame graph updates smoothly and no longer looks jagged

The bottom screen polled frame times at 10 Hz, so the trace advanced in steps of several frames, and it plotted every sample across a much wider area than the in-game HUD, which made per-frame jitter look like noise.
fix: drop the HUD watermark and use the wordmark in headers
Drops the large faint D behind the content on the in-game stats panels, the bottom screen monitors and the on-screen HUD.
feat: Add the Game Jolt store

Adds Game Jolt as a store in the Stores tab, built to behave like the itch.io store: browse, search, game page, build picker, installs, library, collections and updates. It also carries a few shared fixes and itch.io changes the new store needed.
gamescope: EA sign-in stays above the EA launcher\'s splash

With the EA app installed (#2036), Burnout Paradise Remastered opens two windows from two processes. The EA app\'s Steam launcher (EASteamLauncher.exe) shows the game\'s \"Authenticating…\" splash as a layered tool window (WSEXLAYERED | WSEXTOOLWINDOW), and the EA app (EADesktop.exe) opens its sign-in and verification window WSEXTOPMOST. gamescope took the splash as the sign-in\'s overr
feat: add size, opacity and hidden-key settings for the PC keyboard

1. Three new session settings in the drawer\'s CONTROLLER → Keyboard group, right under the PC keyboard buttons: Size on screen (25–70%, step 5, default 47 = today\'s height, header included), Opacity (30–100%, default 100, one graphicsLayer alpha over the whole panel so text and borders fade together and touches stay unaffected), and Hidden keys (multi-select of three groups: Es\n2. Row-height clamp
ci: avoid redundant gamescope builds
Gamescope builds currently run for branch pushes as well as manual dispatches. Updating tools/gamescope/release.env after publishing also starts another compilation.
perf(steam): batch compatibility mapping updates

steam-compatibility currently copies and searches the mapping token list for each game it changes. Large default/tool changes, retired DroidDeck-Proton upgrades and x86-64 Proton repointing therefore accumulate quadratic writer work.
Reduce on-screen stick load and honour Low latency off

Holding an on-screen stick costs far more than holding an on-screen button, and turning Low latency off changes nothing for on-screen controls. This reduces both. The frame rate drop has not been reproduced on the affected Samsung phones yet, so this should not be merged until it has been tested on one.
fix(quest): answer denied KGSL timestamp reads so Steam starts on Quest 3
Steam failed to start on Quest 3 with \Session guest exited with status 134\.
fix: Home screen setting keeps DroidDeck in RedMagic Game Space
On RedMagic, turning on \"Use as Home screen\" or \"DroidDeck as Home\" could leave DroidDeck out of Game Space, and it looked permanent even after switching back to another launcher.
feat(battlenet): import World of Warcraft addons from a zip

World of Warcraft, Classic and Forever get an Addons tab next to Launch, About and Install in the Library. It imports an addon zip and lists the installed addons. Each has a small trash button that asks for confirmation before deleting that addon\'s folder, and the button is hidden while a session runs. Other games don\'t get the tab.
fix(storage): Windows installs on a natively mounted card no longer ask for an administrator

Updating a Battle.net game on a microSD card can still fail with \"Please try again after logging on as an administrator\" (BLZBNTAGT00000841) on 0.6.9, which already has #1791. The report: Retroid Pocket 6, Android 13, World of Warcraft: Forever, with SetNamedSecurityInfo(5) in the agent log.
fix: restore single-screen session menu controls
The shared bottom-screen controls added a redundant DroidDeck logo to the single-screen session drawer and removed its controller shortcut hints.
fix: refresh repaired components and render Ubisoft Connect

Refresh and wait for repaired component revisions, preserve offline component controls, and write Ubisoft-only DirectComposition settings through Proton’s Wine registry API, paired with Droid-Deck/DroidDeck-Components#10; 50 Android tests, 153 Python tests and the release APK build pass.
fix(desktop): Steam\'s own header moves and resizes its windows

Steam in Desktop could not be moved by its header or resized from its corners, and its maximize button could maximize but never restore. Dragging sends no NETWMMOVERESIZE, and the client\'s own IsWindowMaximized stays false, while KWin moves the window fine when asked.
Add session log management to setup diagnostics
Add per-session log management in Setup diagnostics and remove the duplicate runtime card from Overview.
fix(desktop): download language packs from the release that has them

The Desktop stayed in English for every language under the Ubuntu runtime. DesktopLanguage.ensure looked for desktop-kde.i18n.txt next to the runtime\'s own archive, and the ubuntu-r1-rc4 release has no index or packs, so it returned without installing anything.
fix(battlenet): use the right artwork for each game
World of Warcraft: Forever showed retail World of Warcraft art and logo, and other Battle.net games showed trailer stills, seasonal promos or low quality images.
Make a hardware mouse and keyboard work like a PC
Closes #1991\nCloses #2075\nCloses #1817
Reduce DXVK render-path pacing stalls on Adreno 722

Spintires holds frames longer with DXVK\'s default tiler heuristics on the tested Retroid Pocket Duo. Select dxvk.tilerMode = False only for SpinTires.exe on Adreno 722 with DD-Turnip 0.4.0. Explicit tiler options and custom configuration files retain precedence.
fix: Auto picks the upstream RADV pair on Xclipse 950 and 960

On a Galaxy S26+ (Xclipse 960), Auto picked nad:radv-xclipse, which is built from a v1.6.0-RC that predates 950/960 support. It ends in CS rejected (-22), a GPU hang, a kernel panic and a reboot. The tester confirmed the RADV-Xclipse-upstream pair (v1.8.0) runs the 960 with no panic, in Steam Big Picture and Disco Elysium.
feat: non-Adreno graphics stack (Venus, open driver pairs, gamescope patches)

Brings the rest of the non-Adreno work from test/non-adreno-all onto current main, on top of the MaliBridge update that just landed. The merge keeps the contributors\' commits, so authorship stays with them (The412Banner, ASEbrahim and others).
fix(fex): skip patches FEX already carries so FEX-2611 builds
The x86-64 Steam client\'s FEX build for the new FEX-2611 release fails (run): 0002-thunkgen-newer-clang.patch no longer applies to ThunkLibs/Generator/gen.cpp.
perf(agent): run diagnostic cleanup off startup thread
Follow-up to #2131. Run abandoned diagnostic-stage cleanup on a background thread so lock acquisition and deleting stale stages cannot block Application.onCreate across app processes.
fix: upload GOG cloud saves in Galaxy\'s gzip + metadata format
GOG cloud saves downloaded from the cloud into DroidDeck work, but saves uploaded by DroidDeck make GOG Galaxy on another PC fail with invalid data for every file:
fix: an unplugged game drive falls back to internal storage

When the drive chosen for games (USB SSD or SD card) is unplugged, DroidDeck keeps treating it as the place for games:
• Installing a Battle.net game to Internal fails at once with "Game storage is unavailable", because the installer checks the missing library folder first.
• The install picker still lists the missing drive's folder as a target.
• With Default storage set to external, store instal
fix: apply the VRAM budget through Vulkan without rejecting allocations

Extend the VRAM setting to Vulkan memory-budget reports for DXVK and D3D12 while preserving real heap capacity and allocation results, removing the hard rejection that caused game crashes in FIT and Discord tests.
fix(input): taps land where touched while a game holds the pointer

Since #2053, while a game holds the pointer, every touch went through the touchpad, even with the touch mode set to Direct. Games that hide the system cursor and draw their own hold the pointer the same way first-person games do, so a tap clicked wherever the cursor already was instead of where the finger touched. In Stardew Valley, tapping New opened Load, and after pressing Back the cursor reste
fix(agent): secure and refresh unrooted log exports

• Keep raw diagnostic staging in private cache and give each exported archive a unique request directory.
• Remove that request directory after the CLI pull, including failed transfers.
• Replace files from the previous extracted snapshot while preserving unrelated destination files.
• Document that the old rooted-device fallback is not scrubbed.
fix: detect D3D12 capabilities and remove redundant game workarounds
Let VKD3D detect D3D12 capabilities by default and remove redundant Caravan, RoboCop, ReSkate, and Cyberpunk feature-level workarounds while preserving explicit overrides.
Show Steam launch options on the Launch tab

Steam games already support editable launch options, but the editor is hidden under More → Edit art. Move it to the game’s Launch tab, where players can find and paste options without opening the artwork editor.
perf: answer chown and bound thermal paths through the proot fast path

I profiled a fresh 1000xRESIST install (2,216 files) to the Thor\'s SD card on current main to see what the PRoot fast path still misses. Reserving space is now 78 s (404 s on 2026-10-04), so most of the earlier gaps are closed. Two things were still reaching PRoot:
fix: Auto components update only DroidDeck-Proton and delete old builds
Fixes the Auto component update problems reported on Discord (\"The new Auto Update Components issues\" thread and the #test-builds report).
fix(hud): isolate strip rendering in a software layer

Steam underneath the full-width strip HUD flickers when its frame graph redraws on HONOR BKQ-N49 / Adreno 840. Render the entire undocked strip through a software layer, and restore the normal rendering layer for other layouts and docked tabs. The existing strip graph redraw cap is retained.
feat: compress idle game memory before low-RAM devices run out

On devices with 12 GB of RAM or less, the session monitor now compresses the game session\'s idle memory into zRAM when memory runs out, so loading spikes no longer get the whole session killed by Android\'s low-memory killer.
fix(components): auto updates follow DroidDeck-Proton only

Auto updates from #2156 swapped DroidDeck-Components nightlies into every installed Proton that ships DXVK, VKD3D-Proton or FEX, including Valve\'s ARM Proton, GE-Proton and proton-cachyos. Only DroidDeck-Proton should track the nightlies; every other Proton should run the components it was built with. This also fixes two Auto problems reported in the test-builds channel.
fix: stop switching between display modes with the same refresh rate (S26 lag and heat since 0.6.7)

On some phones the session window switched display modes about 34 times a second for as long as the session ran. Each switch rebuilt the window surface and re-armed frame generation. That matches the Galaxy S26 Ultra reports of a laggy, hot Steam client and very low FPS in every game since 0.6.7.
fix(library): Keep one Play request per game and show Starting while it prepares
On a game page, Play often looked dead unless the Launch tab was open. This happened with Battle.net games such as World of Warcraft: Forever.
chore: pin gamescope to the DroidDeck-Components p22 release

The pin pointed at a release in this repository after #2029. It now points at gamescope-3.16.29-p22 in DroidDeck-Components, built from main by build-gamescope.yml (run 42272332246) with the same patch set. The release\'s sha256 matches the downloaded asset. The pr2029 release here is deleted after this merges.
feat(components): Auto updates for FEX, DXVK and VKD3D-Proton

FEX, DXVK and VKD3D-Proton now have an Auto / Manual choice on the Default Components page, styled and focused like the GPU drivers page. Auto is the default; Manual keeps today\'s download, import and restore lists.
ci: publish gamescope builds to DroidDeck-Components and never replace a tag

The gamescope build published its release into this repository, which is how main ended up pinning a release here after #2029 while every earlier pin pointed at DroidDeck-Components. It now publishes to DroidDeck-Components with the CI app token, the same way the KDE desktop and Ubuntu runtime builds do, and refuses a tag that already exists.
fix: uninstalling a Flatpak app that Flatpak no longer has removes its folder

If Flatpak no longer has an app\'s ref but its folder under app/<id> is still there (for example after an interrupted uninstall), the app stays in the launcher. Uninstalling it reports \"not installed\" and changes nothing, so the app is stuck.
fix(proton-run): follow a removed DroidDeck-Proton build to the newest one

Since the Preview builds of 11-07, World of Warcraft started from Battle.net in DroidDeck often never comes up. Battle.net closes (that part is by design), and then the game hangs on the DroidDeck logo. The same install works through Steam. It was reported on Discord by several users with components on Auto, across a OnePlus 13, an AYN Thor, a Retroid Pocket 6 and an Odin 3 Max.
fix: library scan and download cancel crash on Android 10
Fixes #2200: on a Pico 4 (Android 10) DroidDeck ran once, then crashed on every library scan.
Unify controller and screen input profiles for game and desktop sessions

Desktop sessions need configurable mouse, keyboard and application actions from a controller. On dual-screen devices, a lower-screen trackpad may already handle the pointer, leaving the physical controls available for other assignments. This PR gives physical controllers and local touch controls a shared profile/action model instead of separate configuration paths.
fix(storage): a Second library folder that is there is used even when its volume state isn\'t mounted

On a Samsung Galaxy S25 (Android 17), a Second library on the SD card (/mnt/mediarw/B2BD-BCFC/STEAM GAMES) works on 0.6.9 but drops to internal storage on Preview. The folder\'s PC games and its Steam library disappear.
fix(input): taps outside the PC keyboard reach the game while it is open

While the PC keyboard from the session menu was open, DroidDeck dropped every tap on the session, including on the part of the game still visible above the keyboard. A user typing a login into the EA app with the PC keyboard couldn\'t then tap \"Send code\" above it: nothing responded until the keyboard was hidden. Their log shows the touch route BLOCKED for the whole time the keyboard was open.
fix(drivers): leaving a driver bundle no longer keeps its runtime half, and the Auto display picks the latest pair

Picking either half of an Android + Linux driver bundle selects both drivers. Picking another display driver afterwards (for example \"Auto - picked by GPU\" to go back to DroidDeck\'s drivers) changed only the display, so every later session still loaded the bundle\'s Linux driver. If that Linux half doesn\'t work, sessions keep failing after the user has \"switched back\", and Components shows nothing
fix(gamescope): direct-touch drags work again in games that confine a hidden cursor
In Direct touch, dragging stopped working in games that draw their own cursor (Balatro, Stardew Valley). A drag moves the pointer but never holds a button down; taps still click.
fix(input): restore the rest of what #1439 removed, and keep the editor on the bottom screen

Follow-up to #2238. An audit of the five #1439 regression reports against current main found these still broken or only partly restored, plus three bugs #1439 introduced. Each item was checked against the code before #1439 (22a675a66^).
fix: keep the bottom-screen menu and layout editor open when the screen turns off

Turning the screen off closed everything open in a session: the DroidDeck menu, the input settings page and the layout editor. On a dual screen handheld that meant a layout being edited on the bottom screen vanished on every sleep, and the bottom screen came back showing the default Dashboard panel.
fix(storage): a Second library on a raw /mnt/mediarw path is used again

A Second library saved as a raw volume path (/mnt/mediarw/<volume>/...) is treated as unplugged on Preview, so sessions run with internal storage only and none of that library\'s games show up. Stable is fine. Reported on a Samsung S25 with /mnt/mediarw/B2BD-BCFC/STEAM GAMES; their Preview log has game storage: internal only, their Stable log mounts the folder at /mnt/droiddeck-sd.
feat: let users turn off the low-storage warning

Pressing Play Steam with under 10 GB free shows the \"Only X GB free\" dialog every time. This adds a \"Warn when storage is low\" toggle in the launcher Settings, next to Animations, and a \"Don\'t warn me about this again\" switch on the dialog itself. Both flip the same setting. When it is off, Steam starts straight away with no dialog.
test: skip the unscrubbable session log test when file permissions are not enforced

SessionLogShareTest.aFileThatCouldNotBeScrubbedLeavesTheFolderUnrecorded depends on a denied write. Root ignores file mode bits, so the test fails on the root self-hosted runner (droiddeck-desktop), as seen in run 42421920730: 3800 tests, 1 failed. #2237 guarded six tests like this one; this is the remaining one.
test: skip permission-denial tests when running as root

The new self-hosted runners run the unit tests as root, which ignores file mode bits, so six tests that depend on a denied read or write fail there while passing on GitHub-hosted runners (seen on #2236):
fix(runtime): an update that brings a new PRoot pack no longer asks to install the runtime again

After updating to a Preview, the app asked to install a Linux runtime that was already installed (RedMagic NX809J, ubuntu-r1-rc4). Install showed no progress. Leaving the app and coming back a few seconds later showed the runtime installed and working again.
